procedure_text: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇70mL，开动搅拌，室温下将14g氢氧化钠(30％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在30℃，将34.8g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为30℃，反应12h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为92.5％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
procedure_summary: The methyl benzoate ester is treated with aqueous sodium hydroxide in tert-butanol at a controlled kettle temperature, cleaving the methyl ester to the sodium benzoate while the benzylic bromide is left intact. In-process HPLC checks the content of the salt, after which the solvent is stripped under reduced pressure and the crude salt is carried straight into the etherification.

conditions.ph_target_stage: workup acidification of the aqueous solution of the kettle residue

steps: remove the solvent under reduced pressure
add water to the kettle residue and stir until dissolved
add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入160mLDMF、11.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.115mol)和17.3g氢氧化钠溶液(30％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(92.5％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物30.7g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.8％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率84.4％。
procedure_summary: The sodium benzoate from the preceding step is added in portions to trifluoroethanol and aqueous sodium hydroxide in dimethylformamide at low kettle temperature, and the alkoxide formed in situ displaces the benzylic bromide to give the ether. The solvent is removed under reduced pressure, the residue is dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated free acid is filtered, rinsed with water, dried and assayed by HPLC.
